title: forge_project is half-honoured: land lists merge requests by the remote URL's project but reads and rewrites descriptions by the setting's
goal: With backlog.json forge_project set, every forge call of land, merge, red-pipeline and ql_deliver uses the same project: forge_list (ql_deliver.py:77) re-derives the project from the URL while read_merge_request and the description PUT (bl_land.py:796) use the setting, so a wrong request's description can be overwritten; bl_intake.py:1199 and ql_deliver ignore it. Found by the SP-befc6yqr review (S2 of ST-qgnjxiol).

run: import sys; sys.exit('forge_project' not in open('_tools/bl_intake.py', encoding='utf-8').read())

repro_reason: running it needs a GitLab forge with two projects
